Professional experience in building inventory management solutions that support monetization strategies such as dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory split and yield management.

About the Role

Netflix seeks a Coordinator for our Series Animation Production Management team to act as a true “second” to our Managers. The Coordinator will understand CG and Hybrid series animation production pipelines. The Coordinator will drive proactive communication and collaboration, partnering with internal and external cross-functional executive stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful execution of deliverables for multiple development projects and productions. This person will serve as a key, central point of contact across Content, Partner Studios, and crews for the entire Adult Spectacle series animation production slate, working seamlessly between Managers and projects to successfully address their needs and simultaneously ensure the creative vision and business objectives are achieved. 

Responsibilities

 Run Production Operations Smoothly

Own tracking for schedules, bids, deliverables, notes, and key production metrics—monitoring for context, accuracy, and follow-through.

Track turnaround times on notes (scripts, designs, schedules, budgets, etc.).

Organize all incoming scripts, designs, cuts, and production deliverables so they are easy to find and share.

Support crews with everyday questions and help keep the team organized and aligned.

Bridge Execs, Content, and Production

Represent the day-to-day reality of production in conversations with Content, Showrunners, and other internal partners.

Communicate with Partner Studios on more than just delivery tools, ensuring reporting requirements and deliverables are handled correctly.

Partner Closely with Managers of Production Management

Act as their right hand: brainstorm solutions, support schedule and budget scenario planning, and help evaluate and track studio bids.

Track show milestones and key dates; flag upcoming deadlines and time-sensitive needs.

Own Tools & Workflow

Be the go-to expert on Netflix production tools and related systems.

Help the team understand how tools connect to real production workflows (not just data entry).

Troubleshoot basic tooling/tech issues and escalate when needed.

Drive Communication & Alignment

Take clear, accurate notes in complex meetings and share concise recaps with owners and deadlines.

Communicate updates cross-functionally with context and nuance.

Make informed decisions when appropriate and know when to loop in Managers of Production. 

Qualifications

4+ years in production coordination, production management, or similar role (series or feature animation experience a plus).

Proven experience managing trackers, deliverables, and complex communication streams.

Strong note-taking and documentation skills in fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environments.

Strong understanding of production workflows and pipelines.

Exceptional communicator, trusted by both Execs and production teams.

Highly organized, able to juggle multiple shows, deadlines, and stakeholders.

Proactive and forward-thinking; anticipates needs rather than just reacting.

Comfortable working independently and in close partnership with Managers of Production.

Strong soft skills: good judgment, positive attitude, gives and receives feedback well.

Technically savvy and quick to learn new tools (experience with Netflix or similar studio tools is a plus).

Available to work onsite (at least) 4 days a week ( M-Th).

Partnership & Communication

Platform Mastery & Curiosity: A high degree of curiosity and the ability to rapidly build a deep understanding of the Netflix Ads Stack to serve as an authoritative resident expert, providing the technical guidance needed to steer partners and internal teams through complex implementations. 

Technical Translation: Proven ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into concrete technical integration plans and explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Partner Advocacy: Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to manage technical relationships and effectively represent partner needs to internal product and engineering teams.

Strategic Problem Solving: Ability to navigate technical ambiguity to identify the most efficient solutions that align with the long-term product vision.

Netflix Games is seeking a Researcher, Games to conduct user research that guides the development of a diverse slate of games across cloud and mobile platforms. You will conduct studies and analyses to ensure Netflix is prioritizing insights from our members and players - specifically, understanding their needs, behaviors, and feedback. We’re looking for someone with ample experience impacting games with research, influencing game product partners, and managing multiple diverse games in a fast-paced environment. This is an opportunity to help the organization understand and deliver on player needs.

This role sits within the Games Consumer Insights team, which blends audience insights with UX Research to provide a holistic view of our players.

Responsibilities:

Conduct user research throughout game development, from prototype to late stages (alpha and beta).

Stand up and manage user research testing - including moderated/unmoderated, large/small scaled, employee/player facing, and closed/open playtests for both cloud and mobile games.

Share your results with studio partners and game leaders in concise, data-informed presentations that drive clear actions that benefit our games and players.

Stay close to developer needs and be flexible with emergent needs throughout development.

Improve and maintain playtesting capabilities (whether leaning on external facilities or conducting in-house), ensuring environments meet the needs of diverse games and teams.

Improve existing processes for participant recruitment, build distribution, player segmentation, feedback collection, and data reporting.

Track and report on key metrics to demonstrate the impact on game quality and business outcomes.

Stay current on industry trends and emerging technologies in playtesting and user research.

4+ years of hands-on experience conducting user research, especially in running playtests that yield both qualitative and quantitative measures.

Experience in a variety of user research paradigms and specs, including:

Remote and in-person

Couch co-op settings

Kids and parents

Various player input methods (e.g., touch vs controller)

Direct experience with a range of gaming studios and ideally in a high-volume environment where dozens of games are being developed or released at any given time.

Proficient in running games research projects end-to-end on your own with minimal supervision.

Familiar with relevant statistics for data analyses (e.g., significance testing, sample size requirements).

Comfortable operating in ambiguity and good judgment in when to borrow versus when to build and when to partner with an external vendor vs DIY internally.

Deep empathy for both players and developers; passionate about delivering high-quality player experiences.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to synthesize complex requirements and present clear recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.

The Netflix Series Animation Contract Management team sits within the UCAN Business Affairs team and is responsible for ensuring that Above-The-Line (ATL) talent on our are paid correctly and on-time, as well as tracking a variety of important option dates and deadlines. 

The Role:

This is a highly cross-functional role, and the successful candidate must have the ability to work effectively and collaborate with the Business Affairs, Production Finance, Payroll, Labor, Tax, Production, Post Production and Creative teams. This person will also act as a strategic thought partner to those cross-functional teams across innovative deal structures. The Contract Management Coordinator will have extremely strong organizational skills and a high level of attention to detail, as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills. The successful candidate will exemplify the core Netflix Values, be adaptable to change, and be able to juggle multiple responsibilities at the same time. This person will need to be self-motivated and must have the ability to work proactively, independently, and reliably under tight time-frames in a fast-paced environment. 

In This Role You Will:

​Proactively review, evaluate and execute the contractual ​financial ​obligations of agreements and deal terms for ATL talent working on our series, both domestically and internationally. Our team handles payments for rights, scripts, writers, producers, consultants, casting and voice directors, production companies and more. The payments we handle can cover projects from development through launch of the series.

Prepare one-time payment authorizations and recurring payment schedules for ATL talent to facilitate timely and accurate payments. Payments are processed internally via accounts payable or payroll. Our team provides guidance for applicable guild minimums, as well as guild PH&W rates and caps. In addition, you should be familiar with loan out corporations, pay entities, local tax withholding obligations, etc. 

Track deadlines for ATL deals from the development phase through reversion, including subsequent seasons, talent and rights option deadlines and hold periods. We draft and issue relevant notices, including extensions, and option exercise notices. We track writers' room engagements, various development and production milestone deliveries, and order-to-series deadlines. 

Collect ATL payroll start paperwork, and ensure that it is accurate and complete. 

Serve as one of the points of contact for onboarding and offboarding above-the-line talent within Netflix Series Animation to ensure an excellent experience for our talent.
